content: {"praised":["Cinematography and staging create a gloomy, eerie turn‑of‑century London.","Rupert Everett delivers a surprisingly engaging performance.","The music score is captivating and enhances the film.","Characters are believable and compelling.","Visuals are beautifully shot."],"criticized":["Dialogue feels copied from original Doyle stories.","Film lacks originality, feels like a ripoff.","Rupert Everett’s Holmes lacks charm and compassion.","Watson’s acting is weak and unconvincing.","Opening scenes are too slow, dragging pacing."]}
